projectDescription: Official grassroots campaign website for Alex Schnell's congressional run in Pennsylvania's 3rd District, built openly by the community using HTML and CSS.
keyFeatures: Constitutional governance framework based on Article I, Section 8 enumerated powers
Pocketbook issues including term limits, transparency, and local campaign funding
Grassroots, community-built campaign website hosted openly on GitHub
District-verified donation system restricted to PA-3 residents
Public legislative document archive with 'Day One' bill drafts
Open contribution model with automated site integrity checks via GitHub Actions
publicApiSurface: Donation form via PayPal with Census API district verification
Campaign updates via embedded X (Twitter) feed
PDF document viewer for legislative drafts
